title: Install the exact-origin Local Network Access policy
evidence_required: FT-003-AC-017 RED: no source-managed Chromium Local Network Access policy exists; GREEN: the effective managed kiosk policy contains LocalNetworkAccessAllowedForUrls with exactly the central Face Moment origin and no wildcard/unrelated origin, survives browser restart and makes that origin eligible for the later ESP32 integration while an unlisted origin receives no pre-authorization; decisive comparison: scripts/check-kiosk-lna.sh compares source and chrome://policy/effective policy plus listed/unlisted-origin probes without reading secrets; artifact: redacted inspection under .tasks/TASK-063-T3-FT-003-W1/.
purpose: Own the deployable/reversible managed Chromium LNA prerequisite independently of sensor application code.
success_outcome: Only the central Face Moment origin is pre-authorized for local-network access in the managed kiosk profile.
anti_goals: Do not implement ESP32 polling/CORS/Bearer behavior.
Do not use wildcard or store any sensor/display secret in policy.
Do not change kiosk sandbox, SSH or port topology.

forbidden_scope: Kiosk/SSH/port controls owned by TASK-049, TASK-064 and TASK-065
stop_conditions: Effective Chromium policy cannot represent the exact origin.

constraints: Use a source-managed managed-policy artifact and focused read-only check.
Authorize exactly the configured central Face Moment origin.
invariants: No credential is stored in policy.
TASK-046 depends on this task for real-browser sensor integration.
verification_targets: Listed versus unlisted origin eligibility probe.
